notes:
- Play starts a fresh round. Back saves a supported unfinished round for Active Games, and Quit clears the current round.
- The game toolbar keeps the title and back arrow on the left, with game audio and Pause/Resume on the right. The circled speaker in Game Audio mutes all game sound and keeps your volume settings.
- The Cats vs Dogs cover stays the same size while browsing. Get Games labels the current installed version.
- Updated the game SDK guide for save and resume behavior, toolbar layout, and online controls.
- Incoming calls can still be missed while the recipient’s screen is off.
